verdicts.explanation: The value 3.1 × 10−5 S/m is correctly taken from Table 1, but it is a model input parameter and the paper gives no citation or source for it, so 'literature_cited' is not supported by the text. The record's own notes say the origin is uncertain, so under the strict rule it is unsupported.

The introduction states that Na SSBs paired with Na-ion-conducting sulfide solid electrolytes can reach up to 32 mS/cm at room temperature, citing ref [5], so the value, unit, room-temperature condition, and literature_cited origin all match the paper.
